release_notes: Testing release: compact grouped reveal results fit the available screen, with clearer Correct/Missed and optional confidence details. Redundant question metadata removed. Content V6 preserves 700 questions across 14 packs, with 336 rewritten/replaced prompts and 28 revised choice pools after review of all questions and reported contexts. Multiplayer remains 2–8 players. Physical Android and subjective content review are pending human testing.
